label_policy: Released positive CA row-index pairs; full CA Cartesian complement is negative, following DIPS-Plus build_complex_labels. Stored sampled neg_idx is not used.
prior_test_exposure: Underlying DB5 test complexes were examined in earlier project experiments. This is a fixed benchmark rerun, not a new blind holdout.
normalization: Training-only median imputation and z scaling, clipped at +/-10; missing masks appended.
sequence_check_limit: Exact pair sequences checked; shared chains and homologous families can still cross splits.
